name: Studio Hand on Hip Power (Portrait)
tips: Stand tall with chest lifted and shoulders rolled back
Place one hand firmly on the hip with elbow pointing outward
Let the opposite arm hang naturally or rest gently at your side
Shift weight slightly to one leg for a relaxed contrapposto
Keep chin level or slightly lifted — project confidence
Engage your core for a clean silhouette
camera_cues: Key light at 45 degrees with soft fill for studio portrait look
Shoot at eye level or slightly below for a powerful upward angle
Full-body or 3/4 crop depending on backdrop height
Seamless gray or white backdrop recommended
Use a 50mm–85mm lens for flattering compression
